This contradicts the shipped changelog/agents.d claim. Suggested fix: extend the denylist (`__import__`, `importlib.import_module`, `getattr`, `exec`, `eval`, `compile`, `os.abort`, `os.kill`, `os.exec` prefix), count star imports as a control, and count Attribute `_exit`/`exit` on a non-Name base.

  PROBLEM: Exits and skip markers share one `skips` count, so removing `@pytest.mark.skip(...)` (as in the _TO_BASE_TEST fixture) and adding `import os` plus `os._exit(0)` keeps skips=1.
  WHY: The check allows the edit, os._exit(0) ends collection with status 0, CI reports success and no test runs; the last run introduced this case. Suggested fix: keep a separate `exits` counter and refuse when `after["exits"] > before["exits"]`.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:line 1410, matched at lines 1455-1458 | severity=NIT | confidence=3

  WHY: A strengthening heal gets skip_added and exit 42 `detail=test_only_lock`; this fails closed. Suggested fix: count a bare exit name only as the `func` of an ast.Call or the `exc` of an ast.Raise.
